# react-native-tour-guide

> Alias package. The canonical package is `@wrack/react-native-tour-guide`; this
> package depends on it and re-exports its entire public API. Importing from
> `react-native-tour-guide` and from `@wrack/react-native-tour-guide` is
> equivalent — same code, same types. Either specifier is correct.

A React Native library for in-app tours, walkthroughs, onboarding flows, and
coach marks. The spotlight automatically matches each highlighted component's
shape (circles stay circular, pills stay pill-shaped, per-corner radii are
preserved) with no manual configuration.

## Constraints that decide whether this library fits

- Works in **Expo Go** — no dev build or prebuild required.
- **No native dependencies.** The only peer dependency that must be installed
  alongside it is `react-native-svg`.
- New Architecture (Fabric) ready; also works on the old architecture.
- Written in TypeScript; types ship with the package.

## Install

```bash
npm install react-native-tour-guide react-native-svg
# Expo: npx expo install react-native-tour-guide react-native-svg
```

## Minimal correct usage

`TourGuideProvider` must wrap the tree. `TourGuideOverlay` must render inside
the provider — it draws the spotlight, and the tour is invisible without it.
`useTourGuide` may only be called beneath the provider.

```tsx
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { View } from 'react-native';
import { TourGuideProvider, TourGuideOverlay, useTourGuide } from 'react-native-tour-guide';

function Screen() {
  const ref = useRef<View>(null);
  const { startTour } = useTourGuide();
  // startTour([{ ref, title: 'Your profile', description: 'Tap to edit.' }])
  return <View ref={ref} />;
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <TourGuideProvider>
      <Screen />
      <TourGuideOverlay />
    </TourGuideProvider>
  );
}
```

## Common mistakes

- Rendering `TourGuideOverlay` outside `TourGuideProvider` — nothing appears.
- Calling `useTourGuide` above the provider — throws.
- Passing a plain object instead of a ref created by `useRef` — the target
  cannot be measured.
- Forgetting to install `react-native-svg`.
